questions.explanation: H₂SO₄ + Na₂CO₃ → Na₂SO₄ + H₂O + CO₂। H₂SO₄ = 0.020 L × 0.265 M = 5.3 × 10⁻³ mol। 1 : 1 অনুপাতে Na₂CO₃ = 5.3 × 10⁻³ × 106 = 0.5618 g (c)।
